note: REVIEW ONLY. Nothing is added. Most of these are future assertions inside QUOTED source material — whether the Predictions section admits an attributed forecast is a standing policy question, and this pass does not answer it. No anchor check runs: record 4 is deliberately elided ('He ... will provide'), so a verbatim test would fail on a record that is not being applied anyway.

records.why: It is a concrete future commitment, but it may be better treated as a statement of policy than as a prediction.

records.reviewSentence: The Democrats will threaten a government shutdown.
